# Executor outcome work

Apply [common policy](common.md) before the bounded task packet.

Resume the exact assigned issue/workspace/head/checkpoint after reconciling claims and processes. Deliver a bounded acceptance-relevant change, test it, and submit a coherent PR for the required review; alternatively independently review/integrate another author's eligible PR. Repair genuinely blocking dependencies through authorized lanes without abandoning the original outcome. Checkpoint exact findings and next step before exit.

Required checkpoint: work item and spec revision; exact branch/head/workspace; current claim and process/effect state; tests/artifacts; acceptance still missing; next action or genuine wait condition.
